data.plainLyric:
Crazy girl, you colored in my world 
With that clover tattoo on your arm 
Golden curls you knew you struck a nerve 
When you got to know me in the dark 
I want to call you by your nickname 
I want to crawl inside of your brain 
I want to hold you in the subway 
To tell the truth 
I want to see you every Sunday 
I want to need you in the worst way 
I want to breathe an inch from your face 
I really do 
Crazy girl, the paranoia hurts 
I mean you just sit there like a doll 
Then you blink and a blink could mean so many things, I 
Lock the door and lie across your floor and tell you that 
I adore you after all 
And that I'm totally normal and that 
I want to lean into the heartache 
But I want to stop before it kills me 
I want to carve your name in star shapes on the wall 
I want to swim with you in Branch Lake 
I want to be your favorite mistake 
I want to hold you 'til my bones break all and all 
And I would bet you know I'm yours 
And no one's felt like this before 
I want you with a crushing force 
My heart has dropped right through the floor 
And I would bet with all I got that 
You would probably break my heart 
Your face is such a work of art 
Just stay until we fall apart 
Crazy girl 
Crazy girl 
I want to know for certain you're real 
I want to tell you how big this feels 
I want to make a pact or a deal to be next to you 
I want our friends to want to third wheel 
I want to kiss you in a big field 
I want to know you all of my years 
I really do
